purpose: Measure learned cutoff error separately from frozen V14 candidate-selection error; research development only, not confirmation
candidate_generator: V8 fallback plus frozen V13 top-four mask projections, exactly as V14
selector: V14 selected index is the sole deployable candidate choice; oracle candidate choice is diagnostic only
training_role: train2863 only, with sha256 example-grouped holdout fold 0/5
training_examples: all five candidate trajectories and thirteen prefixes per query
targets: per-prefix exact-lattice F1 >= each attainable fidelity anchor; unattainable anchors masked
known_ambiguity: mask 0.90 loss for train prefix masks shown to flip 0.90 in G0A; preserve final evaluation contract
model: frozen V13 question/packet embeddings; mean selected packet embedding, query interaction, prefix length/token fraction; 128-hidden MLP with five anchor outputs
endpoint: step400 only; no checkpoint or threshold search
decision_rule: for each active anchor choose earliest prefix at or after previous cutoff with predicted sufficiency >=0.90; if none choose highest predicted sufficiency, tie earliest; enforce nondecreasing cutoffs
evaluation: one fixed train-heldout and one design-exposed internal300 replay; report learned versus same-order oracle cutoff for V8 fallback, V14 selector, and oracle candidate diagnostic
